name: PT Bank Mestika Dharma Tbk
summary: PT Bank Mestika Dharma Tbk provides banking products and services in Indonesia. It offers saving accounts, current accounts, and time deposits; and multi-purpose, house, car, and land loans, as well as trade finance, working capital loans, and investment credit services. The company provides mobile, Internet, and SMS banking; ATM card; safe deposit box; export and import; money changer; telegraphic transfer; foreign exchange and money transfer; tax payment facility; auto debit facilities; and virtual account services, as well as bancassurance products and services.
